At Offchain, we aren’t just building products: we’re leading a movement.
As pioneers in blockchain scalability and security, we're at the forefront of transforming how the world interacts with decentralized applications. We're laying the foundation that will define the next generation of digital commerce, governance, and human interaction. This involves tackling real-world challenges that come with scaling blockchain technology, without compromising on its core principles: decentralization, security and transparency.
At the center of this vision is our people. Our team is made up of thinkers and doers that embrace new challenges and seek solutions that push existing boundaries. If you’re energized by solving unprecedented problems, and believe in the role that decentralized systems will play in creating a more equitable digital future, then we want to hear from you.
Why Offchain?
Offchain is setting the pace for the entire Ethereum ecosystem. We built the Arbitrum stack that powers Arbitrum One, the most widely adopted Ethereum scaling solution that exists today.
Arbitrum’s ecosystem is undergoing tremendous growth with hundreds of projects and dApps on Arbitrum One today. Over 100 different teams have used Offchain technology to build their own Arbitrum chains. Major players in the space, Robinhood, BlackRock, Ethena Labs, Securitize, Aave, and Apechain are all using the Arbitrum stack.
Arbitrum’s thriving ecosystem wouldn’t exist without our advanced technology stack. Arbitrum, Prysm, ZeroDev. These aren’t just product names. These are tools that are actively reshaping what's possible on Ethereum and advancing its core infrastructure.
To top it all off? We’re backed by $124 million in funding. We’ve demonstrated consistent execution with billions in secured value, thousands of supported projects, and infrastructure processing millions of transactions seamlessly.
What is the role:
Offchain is looking for a strategic, hands-on Senior Product Marketing Manager to drive go-to-market and growth for ZeroDev, our smart account and wallet infrastructure for developers, fintechs and financial institutions building programmable finance. This role is made for a builder who thrives at the intersection of product, sales and growth, and who can connect every campaign to pipeline and revenue.

title: KOL and Social Manager
description_excerpt:
ABOUT US

ether.fi http://ether.fi/ is one of the largest crypto companies in the world. We have over $10B in assets under management and a team of around 50. We've been profitable since day one and are focused on building real consumer applications.

The future we envisage is true on-chain banking. Our current products, Stake, Liquid and Cash, let users earn yield across a range of DeFi strategies and spend their assets in the real world with our cards. You can view public analytics on Dune for Cash https://dune.com/ether_fi/etherfi-cash and Stake https://dune.com/ether_fi/etherfi.




POSITION OVERVIEW

We're looking for a KOL and Social Manager to find, sign and manage KOLs (key opinion leaders: creators and influencers) who bring real users to ether.fi, and to run our day-to-day social posting. This is a user acquisition role: a KOL partnership is worth keeping only if it refers quality users.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Research and scrape to find KOLs whose audiences match our users

 - Build your own tools to speed up sourcing and tracking, using AI-assisted coding (vibe coding)

 - Recruit KOLs, set them up with referral tracking and manage the relationships

 - Track referred users per KOL and cut partnerships that don't perform

 - Spend about an hour a day posting across ether.fi's social channels




YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS

 - Build a roster of 10-20 KOLs, each referring more than 50 quality users a month




WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

 - You can vibe code: you build simple tools and scripts with AI to get work done faster

 - Strong research skills, including scraping to build lists and find people

 - Comfortable posting and running social accounts daily

 - Prior KOL experience is not required

 - Drive, willingness to work hard and go the extra mile. We are a highly ambitious, driven team with audacious goals, and we work very hard to make them a reality

About us
ether.fi is one of the largest crypto companies in the world. We have over $10B in assets under management and a team of around 50. We've been profitable since day one and are focused on building real consumer applications.
The future we envisage is true on-chain banking. Our current products, Stake, Liquid and Cash, let users earn yield across a range of DeFi strategies and spend their assets in the real world with our cards. You can view public analytics on Dune for Cash and Stake .
